source.title: Pseudocompact Topological Spaces: A Survey of Classic and New Results with Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL. Queried the zbMATH REST document endpoint for id 6897708 and recovered the exact record: Zbl 1411.54002, DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-91680-4, ISBN 978-3-319-91679-8 / 978-3-319-91680-4, title Pseudocompact Topological Spaces: A Survey of Classic and New Results with Open Problems.

Attempted the DOI landing page and Springer book page. The Springer page confirmed the same DOI and title but was a subscription preview, not readable full text; it exposed only overview, table of contents, purchase/access options, front matter/back matter PDF links, and chapter landing pages.

Inspected a representative Springer chapter page for DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-91680-4_6. The page metadata reported no access and Full HTML was not available, so it was rejected as paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. Direct PDF endpoints were attempted but did not yield a readable primary PDF artifact.

Ran exact-work recovery searches using the exact title, DOI, ISBN, and Springer chapter DOI. A ResearchGate candidate for chapter 7 appeared to match the same book/chapter and to contain uploaded full text, but the page could not be opened or downloaded as a primary artifact with the available tools. Search snippets and metadata-only records were rejected under the source adequacy rules.
Mapping was skipped because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered.

Candidate extraction was not performed because the accessible artifacts were resolver metadata, subscription previews, table-of-contents pages, or search snippets rather than source text containing open-problem statements.
Source adequacy gate failed: no readable exact-work primary source was available. Returning the standard invalid_or_unreadable_input item with accepted set empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/6897708.json and outputs/latest.json.
